season.source: https://www.newlondonoh.com/departments/parks_recreation.php ('Camping opens May 1st 2026 and closes November 1st 2026'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Water and electric $50, full hookup $60 a night, primitive $40 (weekly, monthly and season rates too; special events add $20 a night). Rates cover 2 adults and 2 children; extra people $5.

summary: $50-60 confirmed from the 2026 brochure; added May 1-Nov 1 and dump; note trimmed.
flags: LOCAL: public can book an ordinary night by phone. Gate: W&E $50, on the line; primitive $40 is primitive-only. Brochure also lists 'Campground Admission Fri/Sat/Sun $3'; unclear whether it falls on campers (overnight guest $5). If it does, weekend nights pass $50.
PHONE CONFLICT: same page gives Brittany Roeder (419) 929-8609 (stored) and the Parks & Recreation Manager contact block Joe Thomas (419) 929-8069. One may be a transposition; kept the stored number.

WATERFRONT: plotted site map on imagery. 'lakefront' holds for the W&E loop 120-131 and 118-119 at the pin (open point, ~50 m from the reservoir behind a row of cabins; primitive T111-114 on the bank), but full-hookup lots 1-103 sit behind it, about 150-400 m from the water. Most RV sites are not lakefront. It is an above-grade reservoir with a dike on the north shore; campground is at pool level on the point, not below it.

LONG-STAY CHARACTER: sold by night, week, month and season, with a seasonal contract form; imagery shows dense settled trailers on the north full-hookup loops. No seasonal count posted. Ownership is local so the private five tests do not strictly apply; noted for you.
Pin OK (on the W&E loop). Amperage unstated, so electric left unset.
note: Village of New London campground on the village reservoir, 2495 Euclid Rd, with cabins and a beach. Sites sell by the night, week, month or season. --Claude
